# Yang--Mills frontier audit

Strongest defensible classification: **C3 conditional abstract
representation-transfer theorem**, with a **C0 methodological Yang--Mills
application**. It is not a C3 construction of Yang--Mills theory.

| Clay-chain obligation | Status in this paper |
|---|---|
| finite regulator and gauge-invariant observable data | represented abstractly; no new lattice construction |
| gauge descent with global sector coverage | open |
| volume-uniform RG control | open |
| large-field and boundary-uniform estimates | open |
| continuum Schwinger functions | assumed in the final interface, not constructed |
| reflection positivity after all limits | open |
| OS Hilbert-space reconstruction | cited theorem, conditional on axioms |
| dense centered physical observable core | explicit hypothesis; not proved for 4D Yang--Mills |
| one physical exponential rate | explicit hypothesis; not derived from the package's restricted estimates |
| spectral exclusion from Euclidean decay | proved abstractly |
| positive physical mass gap | follows only if every preceding premise is independently established |
| nontrivial interacting continuum theory | open |

The result closes only the last logical arrow under transparent hypotheses:

> recovered continuum semigroup forms + core completeness + one uniform
> physical rate \(\Longrightarrow\) target spectral exclusion.

It does not close the dominant constructive interfaces that would produce
those hypotheses. Finite-volume gaps, local Hessian floors, transfer-matrix
eigenvalues at fixed regulator, and restricted correlator decay must not be
reported as the physical mass gap.

Required submission language:

> The Yang--Mills case is a full-chain diagnostic. The paper proves no new
> construction of four-dimensional continuum Yang--Mills theory and supplies
> no unconditional mass-gap estimate.
